name: @app/core-runtime
description: The sealed core behind an extern-function ABI. It loads a JSON cassette, interprets it via HQDM + @core, and reaches the outside world (time, external/API data) ONLY through host-supplied extern functions. wasm-adjacent: the only entry is the exported methods (load/apply/read), the only egress is the externs — so it can be sealed into wasm later without changing the host bridge.
